recommended_export_path: Start with fixed single-image grid_thw=[1,28,28] and pixel_values=[784,1536] FP16.
Create a static vision wrapper that removes grid_thw from runtime inputs and supplies precomputed position/RoPE/cu-sequence constants.
Decompose attention to QKV MatMul, scale, FP32 Softmax, V MatMul, and output projection for the 784-token single chunk.
Emit final merger plus three deepstack outputs as named graph outputs.
Export with an opset supported by TensorRT 10.3, initially opset 17, and preserve weight/bias and normalization constants.
Run a separately authorized correctness comparison of the static wrapper against the original PyTorch visual module before any engine build.
Only after graph and numerical gates pass, authorize TensorRT parse/build as a separate phase.
